mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_security_scan( storage_scope, relative_path, owner_user_id, scan_status, diagnostic_status, scanner_name, scanner_version, sha256, detail, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{storageScope}, #{relativePath}, #{ownerUserId}, #{scanStatus}, #{diagnosticStatus}, #{scannerName}, #{scannerVersion}, #{sha256}, #{detail}, NOW(), #{completedAt}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_user_id = VALUES(owner_user_id), scan_status = VALUES(scan_status), diagnostic_status = VALUES(diagnostic_status), scanner_name = VALUES(scanner_name), scanner_version = VALUES(scanner_version), sha256 = VALUES(sha256), detail = VALUES(detail), completed_at = VALUES(completed_at), updated_at = NOW()
